mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy cycle, which reduces discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in the 20d window despite a sustained FEDFUNDS decline of >1% over the same period.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate signals labor market strengthening, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are negative despite UNRATE declining by >0.5% over 20d, or UNRATE decline is not sustained (reverses within 20d).

mechanism_narrative: Growth in the industrial production index reflects expanding manufacturing activity and supply chain resilience, which supports corporate earnings growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) over 60d despite INDPRO increasing by >2% over the period.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the CPIAUCSL above 220 signals accelerating inflation, prompting central banks to tighten policy, which reduces equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL crosses above 220 but SPX returns are positive over 20d, or the crossing is not sustained (reverses within 20d).

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected surge in employment (PAYEMS) above 130,500 signals a robust labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS crosses above 130500 but SPX returns are not positive over 5d, or the crossing is reversed within 5d.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in GDP demand (GDPC1) creates a dual easing environment, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The combined FEDFUNDS decline and GDPC1 rise do not occur simultaneously, or their interaction fails to predict positive SPX returns (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment (UNRATE) paired with rising housing demand (HOUST) indicates labor market strength and consumer spending growth, both driving corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The UNRATE decline and HOUST rise do not co-occur, or their combined effect fails to predict positive SPX returns (p > 0.05 over 60d).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals anticipated tightening, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) over 20d despite a sustained FEDFUNDS decline of >1% in a late-cycle expansion regime, or FEDFUNDS decline reverses within 20d.
